name: Swift CLI JSON envelope encoding
probe_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time

samples = []
for _ in range(2):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ['swift', 'test', '-c', 'release', '--filter', 'MelixCLITests/MelixCLIRunnerTests'],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0
    sys.stderr.write(completed.stdout)
    sys.stderr.write(completed.stderr)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
    samples.append(elapsed_ms)

print(json.dumps({
    'elapsed_ms_mean': round(statistics.fmean(samples), 3),
    'elapsed_ms_min': round(min(samples), 3),
    'sample_count': float(len(samples)),
}, sort_keys=True))
PY
